ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, points E and F are the midpoints of $BD$ and $CE$ respectively. If the area of $\triangle ABC$ is 32, then what is the area of the shaded part $\triangle AEF$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} \\
Since point $E$ is the midpoint of $BD$, \\
it follows that $AE$ is the median of $\triangle ABD$, and $CE$ is the median of $\triangle CBD$, \\
thus, ${S}_{\triangle ADE}=\frac{1}{2}{S}_{\triangle ABD}$ and ${S}_{\triangle CDE}=\frac{1}{2}{S}_{\triangle CBD}$, \\
hence, ${S}_{\triangle ACE}={S}_{\triangle ADE}+{S}_{\triangle CDE}=\frac{1}{2}{S}_{\triangle ABD}+\frac{1}{2}{S}_{\triangle CBD}=\frac{1}{2}{S}_{\triangle ABC}=\frac{1}{2}\times 32=16$, \\
Since point $F$ is the midpoint of $CE$, \\
it follows that $AF$ is the median of $\triangle ACE$, \\
thus, ${S}_{\triangle AEF}=\frac{1}{2}{S}_{\triangle ACE}=\frac{1}{2}\times 16=\boxed{8}$.
